links.outcome: Accuracy of general-purpose multimodal LLMs in Cobb angle measurement versus radiologist reference standard
links.effect: Gemini produced no Cobb angles; ChatGPT failed on 90 radiographs (MAE 58.6°±45.9°); Perplexity and Grok mean differences 18.8° and 24.2°; all exceeded the clinically accepted ≤10% difference.
links.quote: All AI models demonstrated a difference greater than the clinically accepted difference (≤ 10%).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and usability of multimodal LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok) for measuring Cobb angles from radiographs against expert radiologist measurements, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
